dm.title: Direct message
dm.not_found_hint: It may have been closed, or this server is not connected right now.

error.unreachable: The server did not respond. Check the address or ask the owner for a new link.
error.invalid_url: That address does not look right. Use http:// or https:// without a username or password.
error.not_an_instance: There is no OmniDisc server at this address. Check the link with whoever sent it.
error.unauthorized: Your session on this server has expired. Sign in again.
error.no_session: You are signed out of this server. Sign in to continue.
error.forbidden: This server does not allow you to do that.
error.missing_permissions: You do not have permission to do that here. Ask the server owner.
error.too_many_guilds: You reached this server's limit of groups per person.
error.not_found: That no longer exists on the server. It may have been deleted.
error.rate_limited: The server is asking you to slow down. Wait a few seconds and try again.
error.server: The server hit an internal error. Try again; if it keeps happening, tell the server owner.
error.not_connected: Not connected to this server right now. It reconnects on its own; try again in a moment.
error.protocol: This server speaks a version of the chat protocol this OmniGet does not understand. Update OmniGet, or ask the owner to update the server.
error.bad_request: The server rejected that. Check what you typed and try again.
error.invalid_credentials: Wrong username or password. Check both and try again.
error.username_taken: That username is already taken on this server. Pick another one.
error.invalid_invite: That invite is invalid or has expired. Ask for a new link.
error.registration_closed: This server only accepts new accounts through an invite link. Ask a member for one.
error.message_too_long: That message is longer than this server allows.
error.voice_mic_permission: OmniGet is not allowed to use the microphone. Allow it in your system's privacy settings, then rejoin.
error.voice_no_input_device: No microphone found. Plug one in or pick another in Voice settings. You can still listen.
error.voice_no_output_device: No speakers or headphones found. Connect one and rejoin.
error.voice_device_busy: Another app is using the audio device. Close it or pick another device in Voice settings.
error.voice_mic_failed: The microphone could not be started. Pick another one in Voice settings. You can still listen.
error.voice_output_failed: Audio output could not be started. Pick another device in Voice settings.
error.voice_mic_lost: The microphone was disconnected. Plug it back in or pick another in Voice settings.
error.voice_output_lost: The audio output was disconnected. Pick another device in Voice settings.
error.voice_unreachable: The voice server did not answer. Check your connection and try again; if it keeps failing, tell the server owner.
error.voice_timeout: The server took too long to set up voice. Try again in a moment.
error.voice_denied: You cannot join this voice channel. Ask the server owner for permission.
error.voice_dm_unsupported: This server is too old for calls in direct messages. Ask the owner to update it.
error.voice_not_connected: You are not in a voice channel.
error.voice_disconnected: Voice dropped. Rejoin when you are ready.
error.voice_unavailable: Voice is not available in this build of OmniGet.
error.voice_engine_crashed: The voice engine crashed and left the call. Rejoin to try again; if it repeats, send us the log from About → Debug.
error.screen_permission: OmniGet needs Screen Recording permission. Open System Settings → Privacy & Security → Screen & System Audio Recording, enable OmniGet, then try again.
error.stream_unsupported: Screen sharing isn't available on this platform yet.
error.stream_source_gone: That screen or window is no longer available. Pick another one.
error.stream_capture_failed: Couldn't capture the screen. Try another source or restart the app.
error.stream_encoder_failed: Your machine's video encoder couldn't start. Try a lower resolution or frame rate.
error.stream_not_streaming: You aren't sharing your screen right now.
error.stream_viewer_failed: Couldn't open the stream viewer. Try watching again.
error.e2ee: OmniGet could not use encryption for this conversation. Reconnect to the server and try again.
error.e2ee_not_ready: Encryption is not set up yet — the other side has to open OmniDisc once. Your message was not sent.
error.upload_too_large: That file is bigger than this server accepts.
error.upload_failed: The upload did not finish. Check your connection and try again.
error.unknown_upload: That attachment is no longer ready. Attach it again.
error.attachment_corrupt: This file did not survive the trip — its contents do not match what the sender signed. It was not saved.
error.too_many_attachments: You can attach up to 10 files to one message.
error.file_missing: OmniGet could not read that file. It may have moved or been deleted.
error.device_required: This server needs the app to register a device before encrypting. Reconnect and try again.
error.epoch_conflict: Someone changed this conversation while your message was going out. Try sending it again.
error.voice_output_permission: OmniGet is not allowed to use the audio output. Allow it in your system's privacy settings, then rejoin.
error.e2ee_untrusted: The server answered with a device this person never published. OmniGet stopped rather than encrypt to it — nothing was sent. Tell whoever runs this server.
error.attachment_origin: This attachment points somewhere outside this server. OmniGet did not download it.
error.attachment_too_large: This attachment kept sending past the size it declared, so the download was stopped.

voice.title: Voice
voice.listen_only: Listening only — your microphone is not working.
voice.no_output: Your speakers or headphones are not available — others cannot be heard.
voice.quality_poor: Connection: poor — audio may cut out
voice.nobody_hint: Join and invite a friend — voice is lighter than video and works on any connection.
voice.settings_hint: Microphone, speakers, noise suppression and push-to-talk.
voice.no_input_devices: No microphone found. Plug one in, then refresh.
voice.mic_test_hint: Speak normally — the bar should move. Nothing is sent anywhere.
voice.mic_silent: No sound detected. Check the microphone is plugged in and that OmniGet is allowed to use it.
voice.noise_suppression_desc: Filters fans, keyboards and background hum before your voice is sent. On by default; turn off for music.
voice.ptt_key_desc: Leave empty to use voice activity: your mic opens when you speak.
voice.ptt_permission_hint: On macOS a global key needs Accessibility permission: System Settings → Privacy & Security → Accessibility → OmniGet.
voice.ptt_conflict_hint: Another application already claimed this combination. Record a different one, or close the app that owns it.
voice.ptt_refused: The system did not hand this key over, so push-to-talk will not respond.
voice.vad_threshold_desc: Lower opens the mic on quieter sounds; higher needs you to speak up.
voice.e2ee_on_desc: Only the people in this call can hear it. The key comes from this conversation, never from the server.
voice.e2ee_off_desc: The server can hear this call. Server voice channels are not encrypted unless the owner turns it on.
voice.mic_switched: Your microphone was unplugged — switched to the system default.
voice.output_switched: Your audio output was unplugged — switched to the system default.
voice.ducking_desc: Turns everyone else down while your microphone is open, so you hear yourself think. Off by default.
voice.relay_only_desc: Sends all voice through the server's relay instead of straight to the other person. Needs a relay (TURN) on the server; adds a little delay. Applies to your next call.
